en: Ah, a fellow seeker! My name is Eusine. I've followed the legendary Pokémon Suicune all the way here.
They say three Pokémon sleep beneath this tower. Suicune may be among them. Morty agrees with me, you know.
Suicune is the one I want to see. It's said to purify water wherever it runs. Imagine it!
I'm Morty, Ecruteak's Gym Leader. Legend says a rainbow Pokémon will appear before a trainer it chooses.
I've trained here all my life hoping to be that trainer. Something stirs in this tower today. I can feel it.
...Oh, it's you. I came to see the legendary Pokémon everyone talks about. There's nothing here but ashes.
Since you're here, you can make yourself useful. Let's battle!
Hmph. I'm wasting my time. If there were a legendary Pokémon here, I'd have found it already.
